How to choose a pressure washer for patios, cars and driveways

Start with the job you will do most often. A machine that is convenient for washing a car may feel slow on a large driveway; a bulky engine-powered washer can be more equipment than you want to store for occasional garden furniture cleaning.

For patios and driveways: compare flow, reach and attachments

Compare PSI and gallons per minute (GPM) together. Pressure is only one part of the specification: flow tells you how much water the washer delivers. Compare working or rated figures with working figures, rather than treating an advertised peak number as sustained performance. Check hose reach from your water supply and whether a compatible surface-cleaner attachment is included in the price. Follow the surface and washer manufacturers’ instructions.

US model check: Kärcher’s US comparison separates pressure, motor type, weight and accessory connections. It also says its Classic, Compact, K Mini, WCM and K 7 variations are not currently authorized US models and are incompatible with the US power supply. A familiar name on an imported listing is not enough: verify a US model and local warranty. Source: Kärcher US comparison and model notice.

For cars: controllable spray matters more than maximum power

Look for adjustable pressure or an appropriate spray attachment, manageable hose storage and compatible detergent equipment. Do not choose a washer for a car solely because its headline pressure is highest. Check the instructions for paintwork, seals and trim before using it; the right accessory and setting depend on the machine and surface.

Electric vs gas pressure washers

Electric and gas machines solve different practical problems. With an electric washer, check suitable power access and the manufacturer’s cable requirements. With an engine-powered washer, factor in fuel, engine maintenance, weight and storage as well as the purchase price. Choose by the actual rated pressure, water flow and equipment supplied, rather than assuming the power source alone proves which is better.

What makes a cheaper listing good value?

Compare the complete bundle: hose, lance, nozzles, adapters and any surface cleaner. A second listing of the same model can be worth comparing on condition and accessories, but it does not represent a different machine. For refurbished stock, check the written warranty and returns terms. Seller feedback describes the seller’s service; it is not a product reliability score or evidence that the washer has been tested.

eBay vs Amazon: where should you compare?

For Pressure Washers, it is worth checking both retailers rather than assuming one is always cheaper. eBay can be useful for new, refurbished and open-box stock and exposes seller feedback clearly. Amazon can be useful for comparing new-stock availability, delivery options and retailer returns where offered. Always compare the exact model number, condition, warranty, delivery cost and returns policy before deciding.

Seller feedback describes a transaction, not the performance of the product. We do not claim our own hands-on testing or turn a seller score into a product rating.

Pressure washer questions answered

How much PSI do I need in a pressure washer?

There is no single PSI figure that suits every surface. Compare rated pressure with water flow in GPM, the nozzle and the manufacturer’s recommended use. A higher peak pressure alone does not tell you how well the washer will suit your job.

What should I look for in a pressure washer for patios?

Check the patio material first, then compare flow, hose reach and compatible surface-cleaner attachments. Check what is included: buying the attachment separately can change which bundle is better value.

Can I use the same pressure washer for my car and driveway?

It may be suitable for both if the manufacturer supports those uses and the correct attachments and settings are available. Do not use an aggressive driveway setting on paintwork; check the instructions for each surface.

Is an electric or gas pressure washer better?

Compare the specific machines. Check performance figures, power or fuel access, storage and maintenance. An occasional car-cleaning job and a large outdoor cleaning task can justify different choices.

Are seller ratings the same as pressure-washer reviews?

No. Seller feedback helps assess a transaction, while product reviews should concern the exact model. Look for useful details about setup, hose handling, repairs and long-term use, and keep different models or bundles separate.
